text: Week one. Layla books her first visit.
She thinks she's talking to her salon,
and she is.
But behind the message sits ServiceMarket.
ServiceMarket has run home services in Dubai since 2013.
More than 200 vetted partner companies work through it.
Salon at home included.
They already handle booking and payment.
In our pilot, they would add insurance and also the salon's permit paperwork.
That's the capability we are missing.
We look at two big beauty apps.
Urban Company and JustLife put their own brand on the professional at your door,
so the customer relationship moves to the app.
ServiceMarket already sells other company services,
so the salon stays in front.
If Layla ever feels that an app replaced her colorist, ProGol is finished.
Her colorist is the reason she said yes at first place.
So, we chose with three criteria:
Can they run home visits in Dubai today?
Do they work through salons, not around them?
And the one that decides it:
Do they make salons stronger or takes its place?
ServiceMarket passes all three.
That's why, then.
